pause_marker.semantics: Presence suppresses automatic recovery and backup actions; removal is an explicit restoration action.

pause_controls.name: compose_watchdog
pause_controls.pause_action: create the Linux pause marker before stopping writers
pause_controls.restoration_action: remove the Linux pause marker only after the approved service set is verified
pause_controls.scope: UnifiedCollector watchdog only; no unrelated Compose stack is controlled

pause_controls.name: docker_desktop_watchdog
pause_controls.pause_action: create the Windows pause marker before host cutover
pause_controls.restoration_action: remove the Windows pause marker after intentional Docker Desktop state is restored

pause_controls.name: browser_autorecover
pause_controls.pause_action: create the Windows pause marker before browser/container cutover
pause_controls.restoration_action: remove the Windows pause marker only after browser transport approval

pause_controls.name: pg_dump_backup_launcher
pause_controls.pause_action: set BACKUP_ENABLED=0 or create the Linux pause marker before cutover
pause_controls.restoration_action: remove the marker and set BACKUP_ENABLED=1 only after the selected database branch is verified
pause_controls.scope: UnifiedCollector backup task only; no backup is forced during cutover

shared_host_restoration.unrelated_stacks: out of scope and remain under their existing owners
shared_host_restoration.required_receipt: record which listed controls were actually paused, which were never paused, and the operator who restored each one
